permissions: Codex no direct file-backed mapping currently; represented in adapter projection.
plugins: No first-class vendor support outside Copilot.
profiles: Only Codex has native profile section support.
prompts: Prompt templates are not currently projected outside Copilot and Claude.
settings: Settings are adapter-specific in current projections.
memories: Memories remain out-of-band in this repository version.
guardrails: Primarily represented by sandbox/approval settings in target configs.

compatibility_notes: Schema and mapping metadata are expected to be used by vendor tooling.
Adapters may reject unsupported categories unless `--allow-unsupported` is set.
